intro: A song from the New York sessions for Blood on the Tracks that survived the re-recording in Minneapolis, so the album keeps its first, quiet version.

lives.title: New York take
lives.note: Acoustic guitar, bass and harmonica. This take stayed on Blood on the Tracks; the full session is on More Blood, More Tracks.

lives.title: First performance, on TV
lives.note: Played for a television tribute to John Hammond, the producer who signed him — the first time it was performed live.

lives.title: Big band
lives.note: Given the full 1978 band treatment. On Bob Dylan at Budokan.

lives.title: Back in nearly every show
lives.note: After years as an occasional song it was played almost nightly in 2018 and 2019.

others.note: On Diamonds & Rust, the same year as Dylan's album.
